no_active_clinical_pipeline_reason: Commercial-stage medtech company selling 510(k)-cleared reinforced tissue matrix devices (OviTex / OviTex PRS). All disclosed clinical activity (BRAVO, BRAVO II, OPERA, real-world registry) is post-market observational data collection on already-cleared devices, not active pivotal/IDE investigational studies. A future IDE study of OviTex PRS in breast reconstruction is described only as 'potential'. Per scope, no active P1/P2/P3 or pivotal IDE pipeline to report.
